ev.q: Puzzles block progress through the levels until Lara solves them
Lara navigating linear levels, fighting enemies and solving puzzles
Lara can jump, climb and shimmy along ledges and vertical poles or ladders
Lara automatically locks on to enemies and fires with her equipped gun
While exploring, Lara can find large and small Medipacks
hidden artefacts and relics which unlock rewards such as costumes once collected
